tasks.gr7-listening-speaking-t1: Topic: Listening and Speaking (Grade 7 Term 1). Cover introductions, hobbies, daily routine, community vocabulary, and asking for information. Ask learners to select polite dialogue responses, identify suitable follow-up questions, interpret short oral prompts about self and school, and choose pronunciation and turn-taking strategies for short oral descriptions.
tasks.gr7-reading-viewing-t1: Topic: Reading and Viewing (Grade 7 Term 1). Cover stories, advertisements, notices, short poems, and visual literacy. Ask learners to identify main ideas, retrieve key details, sequence events, interpret ad or notice purpose, and answer simple visual-literacy items using picture and layout clues.
tasks.gr7-writing-presenting-t1: Topic: Writing and Presenting (Grade 7 Term 1). Cover friendly letters, personal paragraphs, dialogue writing, captions, and short descriptions. Ask learners to choose correct text formats, order ideas into connected sentences, apply dialogue punctuation, and edit short writing for audience, purpose, spelling, and punctuation.
tasks.gr7-language-structures-t1: Topic: Language Structures (Grade 7 Term 1). Cover present, past and future tense, plurals, possessives, vocabulary building, and punctuation. Ask learners to transform tense forms, choose correct plural and possessive patterns, identify suitable vocabulary in context, and correct punctuation errors in short sentences.
